meta.title: A closed event cannot be bid on

plan.title: Closed RFQ is read-only in vendor portal

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ without creating or searching for another event.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while leaving the buyer session available.
Open the prepared closed RFQ in the vendor portal on its pricing sheet.
Assert that the vendor view identifies the RFQ as closed.
Attempt to change the price without submitting; the read-only sheet must refuse the edit.
Assert that the closed vendor sheet does not offer Submit Quote.
